observations.content: Assistant planned to refactor status output: add shared buildStatusLines(runtime, branch, contextTokens) builder in src/commands/status.ts used by both /om:status command and status-tool.ts tool, returning string[] joined by newlines plus renderTimeline.

Assistant planned a new ledger helper sumSessionCostByRole(entries) returning {total, observer, consolidator} each with costUsd and runs, splitting by cost entry role field (consolidator vs observer), to be added in ledger/types.ts and exported from ledger/index.

Assistant planned to reword timeline notifications: observer start 'om: observer {runId} reading {fmtK} of chat history', observer finish with per-run cost read via readWorkerCost(runCostPath(memoryRoot, runId)) plus +n observations and session totals, consolidator start/done lines, and compaction lines with context percentage and in-flight observer count.
Assistant planned verdict logic for status: warnings for last worker error, pool >= 0.9*consolidateAt, context >= 0.8*compactAt, consolidator running, observers running, else 'healthy'.
Assistant committed to writing the code (said in Vietnamese 'Du thong tin — viet code' meaning enough info, writing code) and grepped tests for old assert strings.

Grep of tests found only fixture strings 'observer +3'/'observer +5' in tests/timeline-message.test.ts:40-44 (coalescer test that builds its own strings) and comments in timeline.test.ts; no test asserts exact hook output or 'om status' lines.

Test directory listing: compaction-cutoff, consolidator, cost, fixtures, ids, ledger.fold, ledger.progress, ledger.projection, memory.paths, pool, render, session.memory, spawn.smoke, status-controller, timeline-message, timeline tests.
Live om-timeline events observed: 'om: observer started (~10,082 tok)' and 'om: observer +21 (~10,082 tok) · $0.4715 (44 runs)'.

Assistant concluded no existing test breakage expected and planned to add new test tests/status-lines.test.ts with a fake runtime cast as any, checking verdict healthy, cost split, topics count 0, pending slices 0, and a warning case via fake lastWorkerError.

Assistant drafted full buildStatusLines implementation: uses foldLedger, poolTokens, rawTokensSinceObservationCoverage, listTopics, readJourney, sumSessionCostByRole, estimateStringTokens, and formats cost as 'session: $X = observer $Y + consolidator $Z'; fields include Workers, Buffer (pool/next observer), Context & files (topics durable, journey), Cost, and last error.
Assistant decided to drop the 'cost per M raw token' metric and the 'last compaction wait' line from status output (kept simple, compared to original status which showed 'last compaction wait: n/a').

Current status.ts content captured: registerStatusCommand uses /om:status, checks runtime.enabled, calls runtime.ensureConfig(ctx.cwd), reads getBranch, sumSessionCost(ctx.sessionManager.getEntries()), renders timeline lines including observers in flight, active observations, next observer, pool, consolidator, last compaction wait, topic files, journey, context, session cost, last error; notifies runtime.timeline then ctx.ui.

status-tool.ts returns off message 'observational memory is off (enable with /om on)', otherwise reads branch from sessionManager with fallback [], renders similar lines joined by newline including renderTimeline, without ctx context usage line.
OM_COST constant defined at ledger/types.ts:23, cost entries are custom entries with customType OM_COST; isCostEntry checks entry.type !== 'custom' || entry.customType !== OM_COST.
ledger/index.ts re-exports types, fold, progress, projection, pool, render, serialize via export * statements.
